amountMode.description: increase for an explicit increase; total for an explicit new total; missing if no amount is stated.

target.description: Payment name explicitly mentioned, such as 家賃; empty if missing.

amountYen.description: Explicit amount in whole yen. Convert 5千円 to 5000. Use 0 only when missing. Never calculate a difference between totals.

endMonth.description: Last affected month as YYYY-MM only when specified. Empty for an ongoing change.

startMonth.description: First affected month as YYYY-MM. Today is 2026-09-13, so 来月 is 2026-10. Empty when unspecified.

cancelled.description: True only when the user cancels the change.
